meta.name: Taco Bell
meta.disclaimer_extra: Taco Bell hands its nutrition to Nutritionix and opens that data from its own site, so these figures come from the export Taco Bell points its customers at. Menu items there carry no totals of their own — every one is composed from its ingredients, each published per 100 g and scaled by the gram weight Taco Bell states for that item. The arithmetic lands within a few calories of the figures Taco Bell prints: a Crunchy Taco computes to 166 against 170 published, a Bean Burrito to 360 against 350. The export was last regenerated 2025-07-17; the menu it describes still matches what Taco Bell sells, but any item launched since will be missing.
